text: Confirmed the stored scenario fails energy_bound at step 578. I'll shrink, replay, and inspect the failure to trace the cause.
Shrink isolated the failure to a single bouncing body. I'll replay the minimal case and inspect the energy evolution.
I've traced a clear energy spike from 1053 J to 1294 J during the wall bounce with no controller input. I'll run a counterfactual with reduced restitution to test the cause.

Shrunk scenario shows single body with restitution e=1 and high horizontal speed colliding with Arena boundary.

- At step 0 energy ~1054 J, speed 43.85.
- Steps 135-137 approaching right wall, overshoot increasing from -0.16 to -0.04, energy ~1053.97 stable.
- At step 138 after elastic bounce, vx reverses from +43.85 to -49.03, speed jumps 43.89 → 49.07, total energy jumps to 1294.6 exceeding allowed 1164.3 with no controller work.

This indicates wall collision impulse / positional correction is adding kinetic energy on high-speed perfectly elastic (e=1) impacts when substepping (2 substeps/step in this fast regime), rather than conserving it. Reducing restitution to <1 or lowering speed eliminates overshoot/gain.

Counterfactual changes e: 1 → 0.9, removing perfect elastic amplification.
